summary: Phase 9 Trust & Safety tested end-to-end. Backend pytest: 26/26 pass serially (test_trust_safety_phase9.py). Frontend Playwright: consolidated 4-tab admin console verified (Overview/Verification/Moderation/Monetization), all 8 health cards rendering with real data (open-reports=12, human-review=5, active-listings=18, throughput-7d=29, signups-7d=63, suspended=0, members-total=63, listing-activity-7d=23), report status transitions (Mark reviewing -> reviewing, Dismiss -> dismissed) confirmed on the UI, listing-remove/reinstate present with counts, verification-override prompt (window.prompt) shown on select change and correctly blocks apply on Cancel + applies with reason. Member flow verified: report-listing-btn on ListingDetail opens report-modal with reason-select/note-input/submit-btn (submitted TEST_ui reports for both listing scam_fraud and user harassment against a76e287f member, modal closes on success); report-user-btn hidden on own profile, present on other members' profiles. Non-admin buyer2 hitting /admin gets redirected to /marketplace. Regression on listing detail: Buy Now, Make an Offer, Message seller, Report this listing all present for verified buyer.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_moderate_user 'warn': `create_notification` is awaited but does NOT audit-log until AFTER the notification; this is fine but on a warn-then-reinstate loop we get a notification storm because there's no cooldown. Consider soft-throttle (e.g. don't send a duplicate warn notification within 5 minutes) so an admin double-click doesn't spam the member.

server.py admin_moderate_listing on 'remove' auto-actions listing reports but does NOT touch reports on message_threads that reference the same listing. If a member reported the seller (target_type=user) via a listing conversation, that separate report stays open — worth documenting so admins know to dismiss those manually.

server.py admin_set_verification: `body.note` is required, but a moderator overriding to 'approved' does NOT re-enable the profile.verified_badge unless a verification_record already exists (line 823 `if rec:` gate). If a manually-inserted user has no verification_records row, the override sets user.verification_status='approved' but leaves profiles.verified_badge=False — no badge shown. Consider always upserting the profile flag.

server.py admin_health: reports counts are simple count_documents on the full collection (no soft-delete filter). If in future we tombstone reports (e.g. status='deleted') the health count won't reflect it. Fine now; flag if lifecycle expands.

server.py create_report: for target_type='listing' there is NO check that reporter != seller (a seller could report their own listing). Not a security issue but harmless spam vector; consider a 400 guard like the self-report user check.
AdminPanel.jsx uses window.prompt for override reason — fine for Phase 9 but should move to a proper modal so long reasons wrap and it's keyboard/accessibility friendly.

AdminPanel.jsx reports queue: the auto-refresh only happens on user actions (refreshTrust / loadReports called inside handlers) — no polling. If two admins are online simultaneously they can double-action the same report. Low-frequency scenario, worth a soft ETag/version guard on POST /admin/reports/{id}/status.
